summary: Trump University, a for-profit real estate seminar business launched by Donald Trump in 2004-2005, used unaccredited 'faculty' and high-pressure sales tactics to push students into packages costing up to $35,000 before collapsing amid fraud lawsuits.

evidence.note: Trump, Sexton and a partner form Trump University LLC in 2004
headquarters at 40 Wall Street; NY education department objects to the name
2007 pivot from online courses to upsell seminars as the housing market turns
tiered Elite packages from about $10,000 to $35,000, credit-limit coaching
company playbook scripts for overriding student objections
top instructor James Harris: no license, criminal record, best upsell rate
2010 Texas probe dropped; later Trump donations to Greg Abbott
renamed Trump Entrepreneur Initiative in 2010 and quietly wound down
three lawsuits settled for $25 million as Trump took office in 2017
Trump Network MLM, ACN and Trump Institute as related licensing scams
Trump Foundation ordered dissolved in December 2018

notes: Org_type company chosen because it was an unaccredited LLC, not a real school; school-or-facility is defensible. Donald Trump kept secondary: the story is built around the business, so no roles and no lifetime rule. covered_span ends 2018 for the related racketeering suit and Foundation shutdown segment. electoral-politics rests on the Abbott donation and the Curiel/presidency link, a modest segment.
